name: Raj Packaging Industries Limited
about: Raj Packaging Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of multilayer co-extruded plastic film and flexible packaging material in India. The company offers multilayer films, laminates, and shrink wrap films and pouches. Its products are used in various applications, such as dairy products, edible oils/ghee, frozen foods/marine products, vacuum pouches, sensitive chemicals, and specialty films, as well as in non-food, food, beverages, pharmaceuticals, household supplies, beauty care, automotive/industrial, agricultural film/seed, and pet food industries. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
